discovery.input: Only a caller-admitted, hash-bound original HTML snapshot; no networking, hidden requests, API generation or JavaScript execution.
discovery.resources: Observed hrefs only: native detail routes, authority notice links, document/download/PDF/ZIP links and same-host next-page links. Preserve meaningful query parameters, remove fragment only. Exclude login/navigation/contact/private-address targets.
discovery.cursor: Exact absolute next URL observed in current page. Caller must acquire/admit it and supply that same URL as the cursor with the next snapshot. Conflicting next links hold quality.
discovery.attachmentParents: Detail-page attachments point to the explicit detail native identity or document identity. Unbound index documents remain source-document resources, not invented project relations.
discovery.redirectsAndPolicy: Shared acquisition owner must revalidate each resource and every redirect, apply host lane/opt-out policy, and admit exact bytes independently; this adapter does not create policy proofs.

parsing.selectorEvidence: Semantic HTML patterns are implemented; complete publisher DOM snapshots were not supplied. Tests are synthetic original-format HTML, not captured real-source responses. A JS-only or changed page with no recognizable fields/links returns held_quality, not empty.
parsing.rawEvidence: Each field preserves original DOM text or href, immutable CSS nth-of-type path (/@href for attributes), native record identity, source SHA-256, schema hash and mapping version. Cleaned observation text never replaces raw evidence.
parsing.schemaHash: Mapping version plus source ID plus sorted recognized field key/label pairs; values do not define schema identity.
parsing.nativeVersion: Admitted snapshot sourceVersion only; no date-derived revision numbers.
parsing.identity: docuuid/BOB UUID wins. Otherwise exactly one nonempty explicit authority and file-reference value produces an issuer-scoped authority-file identity. Conflicting or missing authority/file evidence remains a source-document fallback.
parsing.dateRoles: Publication, source reference, inspection start/end and objection deadline are separate. Only valid exact DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD is normalized. Relative/range/invalid dates remain raw with null normalized date. Retrieval time is never substituted. Conflicting contextual publication/reference dates remain null.
parsing.geography: Only a single unambiguous explicit eight-digit AGS is source_explicit project-location geography. Preserve leading zeroes; scope municipality AGS and place names never establish geographic membership. External verified joins are an integration step.
parsing.legalBoundary: Published status/type and decision-document labels are attributed metadata only. No permit-issued/authorizes/project-completion/payout claim is emitted. Actual decisions, objections, conditions and fulfillment require original residual text evidence and substantive admission gates.

coverage.nonempty: partial: page-local metadata is not complete statewide or municipal coverage
coverage.empty: Explicit empty-result text on a recognized admitted page only; no global absence or deletion
coverage.schemaChangeOrMissingPage: held_quality; absence never synthesizes withdrawn status
coverage.withdrawn: Explicit source status is preserved as a new versioned attributed observation; no historical deletion or inferred legal effect
coverage.livePilotCoverage: not_checked for all nine pilot towns; six source distributions remain held_origin until separate rights admission

limits.encoding: UTF-8 only; invalid input holds quality
limits.onExcess: held_quality with zero rows/resources; no truncation

fixtures.provenance: Synthetic bounded HTML fixtures in native markup, not publisher captures; no normalized JSON inputs or live calls.
